title: P11 — Generate searchable catalog listing and routes
description:
## Dispatch packet P11
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D05 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
videoml-org
Primary paths: gatsby-node; src/pages/catalog; catalog page template. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Consume packed stdlib manifest and implement stable routes/search/category/framework filters, poster-first cards and keyboard navigation. Planned entries are marked unavailable.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
Gatsby build, no missing routes, browser filter/query/back-button checks.

## Dependencies
videoml-fa90b2 (P05), videoml-ca79a1 (P06)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
